wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create comprehensive content for this section focused on the Techno Browser extension as a Google Workspace Add-on. Explain its purpose of automating document tasks across Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides with intelligent analysis, PII redaction, cleanup automation, template application, and summarization. <blog>
# Comprehensive Project Analysis: Intelligent Document Automation for Google Workspace

## 1. Project Introduction

### Purpose Statement
The Intelligent Document Automation add-on is designed to streamline document processing across Google Workspace applications (Docs, Sheets, and Slides) by automating repetitive tasks, detecting formatting issues, redacting sensitive information, and applying templates. The solution aims to enhance productivity while maintaining strict privacy standards.

### Core Goals and Objectives
- Automate common document cleanup tasks (duplicate removal, date standardization, whitespace trimming)
- Detect and redact Personally Identifiable Information (PII) with user consent
- Provide intelligent document analysis and summarization capabilities
- Offer template management for consistent document formatting
- Track usage analytics with privacy-preserving methods
- Ensure all processing occurs locally by default, with optional advanced features requiring explicit consent

### Target Audience
- Google Workspace users seeking to automate repetitive document tasks
- Organizations requiring compliance with data privacy regulations
- Educators, administrators, and business professionals working with structured documents
- IT administrators responsible for deploying and managing add-ons across domains

## 2. Technical Architecture

### Component Breakdown
The project follows a modular architecture with clear separation of concerns, organized into distinct service components:

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Main.js] --> B[SidebarHandlers.js]
    B --> C[DocumentAnalysisEngine.js]
    B --> D[AutomationRuleProcessor.js]
    B --> E[RedactionService.js]
    B --> F[PrivacyGateController.js]
    B --> G[TemplateManager.js]
    B --> H[SummarizationService.js]
    B --> I[AnalyticsService.js]
    C --> J[Utils.js]
    D --> J
    E --> J
    F --> J
    G --> J
    H --> J
    I --> J
    A --> K[Sidebar.html]
```

### Design Patterns
The architecture implements several key design patterns:
- **Service-Oriented Architecture**: Each core functionality is encapsulated in a dedicated service module
- **Privacy-First Design**: All sensitive operations require explicit user consent through the PrivacyGateController
- **Event-Driven Architecture**: UI interactions trigger backend operations through Google Apps Script's event system
- **Singleton Pattern**: Services are implemented as self-invoking functions that return a single instance with public API methods

### System Relationships
The system components interact through a well-defined hierarchy:

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[User Interface] --> B[Event Handlers]
    B --> C[Core Services]
    C --> D[Utility Functions]
    C --> E[Privacy Controller]
    E --> F[User Properties]
    C --> G[Analytics Service]
    G --> H[Script Properties]
    C --> I[Google Workspace APIs]
    I --> J[Docs/Sheets/Slides]
```

### Data Flow Diagram
The data flow follows a request-response pattern with privacy safeguards:

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[User Action] --> B[UI Event]
    B --> C[Sidebar Handler]
    C --> D[Privacy Check]
    D --> E{Consent Required?}
    E -->|Yes| F[Request Consent]
    E -->|No| G[Execute Service]
    F --> G
    G --> H[Process Data]
    H --> I[Update Document]
    I --> J[Track Analytics]
    J --> K[Return Result]
    K --> L[Update UI]
```

## 3. Key Implementation

### Main Entry Points
- **Main.js**: Entry point for the add-on, handling installation, menu creation, and sidebar initialization
- **Sidebar.html**: User interface for interacting with the automation features
- **SidebarHandlers.js**: Bridge between UI events and service implementations

### Core Modules
- **DocumentAnalysisEngine.js**: Detects formatting issues, duplicates, and anomalies across Docs, Sheets, and Slides
- **AutomationRuleProcessor.js**: Executes macro-like operations for batch transformations and cleanup
- **RedactionService.js**: Identifies and masks PII such as emails, phone numbers, and SSNs
- **PrivacyGateController.js**: Manages user consent and enforces privacy policies for data processing
- **TemplateManager.js**: Handles document templates with Drive integration and preview functionality
- **SummarizationService.js**: Provides document summarization with local and optional backend processing
- **AnalyticsService.js**: Tracks usage statistics while preserving user privacy

### Configuration Approach
- **package.json**: Defines project metadata and development dependencies (clasp for deployment)
- **appsscript.json**: Manifest file specifying runtime version and exception logging configuration
- **PropertiesService**: Utilizes Google Apps Script's Properties Service for storing user preferences and analytics data
- **OAuth Scopes**: Minimal scopes requested, limited to current document access and UI display

### External Dependencies
- **@google/clasp**: Command-line tool for developing and deploying Apps Script projects
- **@types/google-apps-script**: TypeScript definitions for Google Apps Script APIs
- **Google Workspace APIs**: Native integration with Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive, and Script services

### Integration Points
- **Google Workspace Add-ons Platform**: Deep integration with Docs, Sheets, and Slides interfaces
- **Google Drive**: Template library integration for shared templates
- **Properties Service**: Storage for user preferences, analytics data, and consent settings
- **CardService and HtmlService**: UI components for displaying dialogs and sidebars

### Component Relationship Diagram
The relationships between components demonstrate a clean separation of concerns:

```mermaid
graph LR
    A[Main.js] --> B[SidebarHandlers.js]
    B --> C[DocumentAnalysisEngine.js]
    B --> D[AutomationRuleProcessor.js]
    B --> E[RedactionService.js]
    B --> F[PrivacyGateController.js]
    B --> G[TemplateManager.js]
    B --> H[SummarizationService.js]
    B --> I[AnalyticsService.js]
    C --> J[Utils.js]
    D --> J
    E --> J
    F --> J
    G --> J
    H --> J
    I --> J
    F --> I
    H --> F
    E --> F
    G --> F
    I --> F
```

## 4. Key Features

### Functionality Overview
The add-on provides comprehensive document automation capabilities across Google Workspace applications:

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Idle
    Idle --> DocumentAnalysis: User clicks "Analyze"
    DocumentAnalysis --> IssueDetection: Scan for problems
    IssueDetection --> SuggestionGeneration: Generate fixes
    SuggestionGeneration --> DisplayResults: Show in sidebar
    
    Idle --> Redaction: User clicks "Redact"
    Redaction --> PIIDetection: Scan for sensitive data
    PIIDetection --> ConsentCheck: PrivacyGateController
    ConsentCheck -->|Granted| DataMasking: Redact PII
    ConsentCheck -->|Denied| Notification: Inform user
    
    Idle --> Automation: User selects cleanup action
    Automation --> RuleExecution: Apply transformation
    RuleExecution --> DocumentUpdate: Modify document
    DocumentUpdate --> Success: Show confirmation
    
    Idle --> TemplateApplication: User selects template
    TemplateApplication --> TemplateSelection: Show picker
    TemplateSelection --> ContentFormatting: Apply styles
    ContentFormatting --> Completion: Notify user
```

### Implementation Highlights
- **Privacy-First Architecture**: The PrivacyGateController ensures all sensitive operations require explicit user consent, with detailed privacy policy disclosure
- **Cross-Platform Compatibility**: Unified codebase supports Docs, Sheets, and Slides with type-specific analysis and processing
- **Modular Service Design**: Each core functionality is isolated in its own service module, enabling independent development and testing
- **Local-First Processing**: All operations run within the Google Apps Script environment by default, with optional cloud-based features requiring consent
- **Comprehensive Error Handling**: Robust try-catch blocks and logging throughout the codebase ensure graceful failure and debugging capability

### Feature Architecture Diagram
The feature architecture demonstrates how different components work together to deliver value:

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[User Interface] --> B[Tab Navigation]
    B --> C[Analyze Tab]
    B --> D[Redact Tab]

    B --> F[Templates Tab]
    
    C --> G[Document Analysis]

    H --> J[Duplicate Content]
    H --> K[Date Inconsistencies]
    
    D --> L[PII Detection]
    L --> M[Email Addresses]
    L --> N[Phone Numbers]
    L --> O[SSNs]
    L --> P[Credit Cards]
    L --> Q[Redaction Process]
    
    E --> R[Automation Rules]
    R --> S[Remove Duplicates]
    R --> T[Standardize Dates]
    R --> U[Fill Empty Cells]
    R --> V[Trim Whitespace]
    
    F --> W[Template Management]
    W --> X[Built-in Templates]
    W --> Y[Drive Integration]
    W --> Z[Custom Templates]
    
    G --> AA[Analytics Tracking]
    L --> AA
    R --> AA
    W --> AA
    AA --> AB[Privacy Consent]
```
